pieces.name: Bias binding (neckline + armholes)
pieces.cut: cut 1 strip(s) 1176 x 25 mm ON THE BIAS (45° to the grain), join end to end (total 1176 mm = edge 1156 mm + overlap), press in half, wrap the edge and trim the excess

pieces.name: Patch Pocket (yama cep)
pieces.cut: cut 2 rectangle(s) 121 x 171 mm (rounded lower corners, fold the top 35 mm to the inside for the mouth hem; sized to 220 mm front panel)
